regions.name: Río Ventuari
regions.quote: Upstream of the Meta's confluence with the Orinoco it has been collected in the ríos Ventuari, Guaviare (including the ríos Ariari and Inírida), Tomo, and Cataniapo, while downstream there exist records from the ríos Cinaruco, Capanaparo, Guárico, and Apure.

regions.name: Río Cinaruco
regions.quote: One example of a natural habitat is the Río Cinaruco, a low nutrient, blackwater tributary of the Orinoco in southwestern Venezuela which comprises a meandering river channel with numerous interconnected lagoons and floodplain lakes.
